description: Land Acquisition - Kaluganga, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land totaling approximately 100.3443 hectares are needed for a public purpose. The document provides detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
